scope.website: Route ownership, safe Blob URL lifecycle, lightweight routine synchronization metadata, bounded read-only Drive checks, and one full IndexedDB clone per store per page session
scope.phone_mirror: 0.2.0 retained; only the website test URL marker changed in MainActivity.java

covers: all five page renderers check ownership before DOM writes
Garage layout rechecks route ownership after each asynchronous settings read
routine Inventory and Listings checks avoid unchanged full-record reconciliation
pending synchronization discovery loads only selected full records
POST/write requests remain exempt from automatic timeout
only one full IndexedDB getAll clone after a store is hydrated
concurrent first reads share one IndexedDB getAll request
individual and indexed reads use the in-session store map
navigation reads remain available while a write is pending
successful writes update the in-session map
